'''R3-M3''' was an [[R3-series astromech droid]]<ref name="LEGO" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="RVG" /> that stood 1.09 [[meter]]s tall<ref name="Databank" /> and had [[Color|blue]] plating and a transparent dome. It served the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ANH" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> the [[astromech droid]] was on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] while it was in the [[Alderaan system]], and rolled down one of the [[battle station]]'s corridors as the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] snuck across the corridor in order to reach the [[Death Star]]'s [[tractor beam]] controls.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
R3-M3 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> It was first identified in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Ultimate LEGO Star Wars]]''.<ref name="LEGO" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity with a wave of ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' figures produced by [[Hasbro]] and released in [[2009]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|packtype=Build-A-Droid|pack=R3-M3|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBADR3M3.asp}}</ref>
